name: A reader sees what a branch changed and reads the model on that branch
summary: The branch footprint answers only in the CLI and the pull-request Action, so a reader cannot see in the browser which modules a branch changed against its own proposal; Measures gains that view, and a branch reading reads the vault at a source ref from Git.

value.name: Branch reading
value.responsibility: Reads the vault as a source branch or commit holds it, from Git, as a model that cannot be edited
value.description: Reads the vault's inputs as they stand at a source branch or commit of the vault's repository, from Git objects, without a checkout. It decodes them as a model that can be read and compared but not edited, claimed or retained, and its revision names the commit it read.

value.label: decode the inputs at the ref
read the vault's blobs at the commit

value.name: Architecture history routes
value.responsibility: Serves locality, the branch footprint and the source refs of a model's repositories
value.description: GET /api/architecture/locality, /api/architecture/footprint and /api/architecture/refs adapt the history lens for the browser and the CLI. Each names its vault, and none keeps an answer.

value.label: footprint, locality and source refs

value.name: Branch footprint
value.responsibility: Shows which modules the commits from a base to a head changed, against the proposal at that head
value.description: The Measures view What this branch changed. Searchable base, head and against pickers choose the range and the state; the lists say which modules the commits changed against the proposal, with skipped modules and unbound files. Show on picture opens the nearest shared parent, at the head's branch reading when the head is not checked out, and selects each changed module it draws and each drawn module that holds one.

value.label: the footprint, the source refs and the states at head
open the shared parent, at the head's branch reading

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#radK8osF
changes.value: The history interface reads canonical states and their bound source declarations. Locality reports change frequency and coupling. Footprint compares explicit local refs and the selected proposal baseline, and lists each changed file that no binding holds, outside the vault. A named head that resolves in the vault's repository is read with the vault at that head, unless the caller asks for the vault on disk, so its proposals and bindings come from the branch; the answer names the vault it read. Source refs lists the branches of every repository the state binds, merged by name. Each changed part names the other changed parts that its binding holds. Missing source stays unavailable rather than being reported as unchanged.

value.label: read the selected state, at the head

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#5SMX69gS
changes.value: The checker reads current architecture, one selected state, or independent drafts. It reports bindings, anchors, declared relationships, interfaces, and document references with canonical identities. Its state reader also reads one selected state at a source ref, through the branch reading, for the branch footprint of a named head. Git locality and branch footprint use separate requested history operations. The timings of its language servers name the program that ran and the TypeScript that it read.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#MrE3v2T6
changes.value: The command passes explicit local source refs and selected architecture to the history interface. With --head on a ref that the vault's repository holds, it reads the vault at that head, so --state names a proposal of that branch; --model-at checkout reads the vault on disk instead, as a gate in the integration worktree needs after it edits the proposal there. Proposal comparisons use their identified baseline. With --fail-outside and a draft, it exits 1 when the commits changed a module that the draft does not name, so a ticket merge without a pull request has a gate like the out-of-plan fail mode of the pull-request Action. A module bound to a directory passes when each file it changed lies in the binding of another changed module inside it.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#nn1ec9Tw
changes.value: Adapts canonical discovery, initialization, exact readings, archive history, branch readings at a source ref, and the existing change feed. Unmigrated vaults receive explicit migration guidance.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#cNaEpWjJ
changes.value: Reads one live canonical model or an exact retained reading. The shared decoder orders collections and walkthroughs consistently. Legacy bytes serve explicit migration and original history only. Module navigation reads a branch reading at its source ref.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#KJy5yYuq
changes.value: Stores compact changes against exact retained predecessors. Consistent decoding keeps predecessor fingerprints stable across live and retained inputs. Changed predecessors require explicit reconciliation or replacement decisions. With a source ref, the selected-state reader reads the vault at that ref through the branch reading, and selects the state and its comparison inside it.

value.label: read the vault at a source ref

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#w46oCRoH
changes.value: Owns the reading address of a pane, including the source ref of a branch reading, so a branch reading survives reload and browser history.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#vvxDSZoQ
changes.value: Resolves explicit references and bound code through the public model reader, and passes a source ref through to the selected-state reader.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk#tQ2B3iEF
changes.value: One history read of a revision answers for every part at once, and a selection shares it. A row selects its module on the picture. An unread part states why, and no count joins a score. A fourth view, What this branch changed, holds the branch footprint.

value.label: the view What this branch changed

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#FlAxCoeb
changes.value: The existing public reader owns model identity, complete revision, state or checkpoint, stable subjects, reading filters, grammar, explicit flow, and the actual proposal comparison base. Missing and stale content refuse coherently. A source ref is refused with a checkpoint, a preview, a legacy address, a walkthrough or an explanation, so none of them silently reads the vault on disk.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk#8539szQJ
changes.value: The model contract names a branch reading's ref and commit, carries the ref in a reading's identity, and refuses an unresolved ref with SOURCE_REF_NOT_FOUND.

value.label: read the branch footprint and the source refs

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk#p0EDMxTr
changes.value: Shows the reading on screen. A branch reading names its ref in the heading, follows no live feed, and offers no edit, claim, publication or walkthrough recording.
